author: profbananaslug
body:
hello lads today I present to you the very latest in mapmaking technologies: bounce mania



it may not look like much, but the 500-line xml is certain to turn it into absolute insanity (if it doesn't accidentally blast everyone into outer space)
loadouts are team colored helm, iron sword, bow, 23 arrows, 2 gapples, 16 fried fish
gamemode is tdm, 1 kills = 1 point, played to 100 or until 8 minutes have gone by
the premise of the map is that two groups of sword-wielding wackos have discovered the world's largest bouncy castle and want to claim it for themselves
enjoy
